module: Flowgraph node "Activity Flow" (category logic, tag activity). Entry point of a mission graph: outputs flow once at start (pin "started"), every frame while the activity is running ("update"), then once at stop ("stopped"). Hidden output pins: dtReal, dtSim, dtRaw (delta times). Without an associated activity (standalone graph), it runs on onUpdate; with an activity, it is driven by the mission manager.
notes: legacyPins renames the old output pins start -> started and stop -> stopped.
The code still writes to self.pinOut.start/stop (old names); this works thanks to the legacyPins renaming.
Also writes the delta times into self.mgr.dtReal, dtSim and dtRaw.
On the 'stopped' state change with an activity: triggers stopped then calls gameplay_missions_missionManager.stop.

start.desc: Sets the "started" flow to true (update and stopped to false) and triggers the node.

onExecutionStarted.desc: Hook: when the graph starts, if an activity exists and is not running, starts it via gameplay_missions_missionManager.start; without an activity, calls start().

onStartActivity.desc: Hook called when the activity starts; calls start().

update.desc: Updates dtReal/dtSim/dtRaw (pins and manager), enables "update" and triggers the node.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook; calls update only if the graph has no activity.

onUpdateActivity.desc: Per-frame hook sent by the activity; calls update.

stop.desc: Enables the "stopped" flow and triggers the node.

changedRunningState.desc: Hook: when the graph becomes 'stopped', triggers stop() and stops the mission (if an activity is running).

onStopActivity.desc: Hook called when the activity stops; calls stop().

drawMiddle.desc: Editor: shows whether an activity is associated and the end of its id.

drawTooltip.desc: Editor: tooltip showing the activity id or the limited compatibility mode.
